rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists several activities that all follow the same preceding event and are performed together, and a later step continues only after all of them are done: Model an opening parallel gateway after the preceding step, with one branch per listed activity, and close those branches with a joining parallel gateway before the next step. Do not chain the activities in sequence, and do not use an exclusive gateway to join them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description lists two or more activities that follow the same condition or preceding step, are performed by different parties or at the same stage, and a later step continues only after all of them are complete

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says a repeated cycle ends when one of several named outcomes occurs (for example graduating or withdrawing), with each outcome leaving the loop through a decision: Place an exclusive gateway after the repeat check, with one labelled outgoing flow per named exit outcome. Model each named exit outcome as its own task on its branch, placed after the gateway and before the end event that closes that branch. Do not route the exit gateway straight to an end event, and do not merge the named outcomes into one generic exit task or into the end event label.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a repeated cycle continues until the actor reaches one of several named outcomes, such as completing the program or leaving it, and each outcome has its own closing action
